positions.title: Web Developer (Product Manager - Fan Experience)
positions.description:
• Spearhead the development of internal and external web platforms enabling rapid creation of websites and landing pages, leveraging frameworks such as React and Next.js.

honors.title: Most Valuable Marketer of the Week
honors.description: Darrell takes lead on all things Sixers.com. In a great example of cross-HBSE cooperation, Darrell worked with David Gould, Matt Ackermann, Mike Rich and Kevin McMorrow on the HBSE collection of Buy Black websites, as part of the overall Buy Black initiative. Darrell built and launched the Sixers' version of the Buy Black website (sixers.com/BuyBlack), incorporating last minute edits and additions right through the holiday weekend. Since going public Monday morning, the Sixers' Buy Black website has already helped Black area businesses submit 300+ applications in less than a week!
honors.issuer: Issued by Brittanie Boyd​, Senior Vice President, Marketing at Philadelphia 76ers · Feb 2021

projects.title: E-Tunes Music Company Database
projects.description:
For the Database Management Systems course, we developed a prototype database and SQL queries using only MySQL that demonstrated potentially functionality for a fictitious music company who wanted to provide a new system to sell music over the Internet. The purpose of the database was to serve both internal to the company users (e.g. seeing customer and sales information) and for external to the customers. 

Primary tasks were the database design along with sufficient data entered to demonstrate our queries. The goals were to have a good database design and correct queries. We divided the 23 assigned queries so that we each worked on 7 queries and worked on the last 2 queries together. We helped each other when one of us got stuck on a query. We simultaneously entered the data into the database together because of the the large amount of data that needed to be entered.
